How encryption works

Single DES uses 64-bit blocks and 16 Feistel rounds. This app implements the initial and final permutations, key schedule, expansion, S-boxes and P permutation directly in JavaScript. CBC uses a fresh random 8-byte IV with PKCS#7 padding. Text results use Base64.

Only DES packages created with this version are supported. Earlier AES packages and raw DES ciphertext are not compatible. File names are encrypted inside the package. Wrong keys usually cause an error, but DES-CBC cannot guarantee integrity.

DES is a historical algorithm for learning and demonstrations. This application has not undergone an independent security audit.
